title: Windowed Hankel KEM: implementation, challenge instances and evidence for Windowed Hankel LWE
description:
Reference and constant-time native implementations of Windowed Hankel KEM, challenge instances of the Windowed Hankel LWE problem, and the scripts and recorded outputs behind every figure of the accompanying paper, Windowed Hankel LWE: A Structured-LWE Problem for Cryptanalysis, with a Compact KEM.

Windowed Hankel LWE is a structured variant of LWE whose public matrix is a Hankel matrix generated by one long pseudorandom sequence. Its hardness is an assumption: the known Middle-Product LWE reductions do not apply. The paper offers it as a problem for cryptanalysis; the KEM is research code and not for production use.
